parties.value: Northwind Retail Group plc (Customer) and Cobalt Cloud Services Ltd (Provider)

service_scope.value: Cloud infrastructure management, monitoring and support services defined in SOWs

payment_terms.value: Fixed monthly fees per SOW; net 30 days, in US dollars by bank transfer

invoice_schedule.value: Monthly in advance on the first business day of each month

late_payment_penalty.value: 1.5% interest per month; suspension if unpaid 15 days after notice

liability_cap.value: Total fees paid in the preceding 12 months; no indirect or consequential damages

indemnification.value: Provider indemnifies Customer against third-party IP infringement claims

ip_ownership.value: Customer owns deliverables on full payment; Provider keeps pre-existing IP with a perpetual licence to Customer

termination_clause.value: Convenience on 90 days' notice; immediate for uncured material breach after 30 days

notice_period.value: Written notice by hand, courier or email; 60 days before SOW renewal for non-renewal

dispute_resolution.value: 30 days of executive negotiation, then LCIA arbitration seated in London with one arbitrator

chat.q: Does this agreement include a non-compete clause for the founders?
